# Household

> Household runs personal assistant bots in Telegram, powered by Claude Code or Codex harnesses. Each bot
> lives in its own microVM within a workspace; a daemon on the user's Mac or Linux machine proxies its traffic
> through an allowlist and puts API keys into requests on the way out, so bots only ever see placeholders.

Setting it up is done when the user writes to their Telegram bot and a bot answers. Work through the
[setup checklist](https://github.com/underwear/household/blob/main/plugins/household/skills/household/install.md).
Household installs with `curl -fsSL https://agents-household.dev/install.sh | sh` (no Bun, Docker or sudo);
`house onboard` then walks the user through the rest in their terminal (harness key, workspace, Telegram channel, assistant bot), and `house update`
moves to a newer release.

Install the `household` skill too, for running Household afterwards:

- Claude Code: `claude plugin marketplace add underwear/household && claude plugin install household@household`
- Codex: `codex plugin marketplace add underwear/household && codex plugin add household@household`

## Docs

- [Quick start](https://agents-household.dev/docs/start/): install, house onboard, house start, then write to your bot
- [Bots](https://agents-household.dev/docs/bots/): what a bot is, how it differs from sideworkers and scouts, and every tab of its page in the admin
- [Sideworkers](https://agents-household.dev/docs/sideworkers/): extra assistants a bot starts for one job: another project's CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md, a thread you can talk in, limits and profiles
- [Inboxes](https://agents-household.dev/docs/inboxes/): mail, feeds, health checks, JSON, Grafana, Datadog, Telegram bot updates and custom HTTP sources; per-bot subscriptions and silent delivery; the custom HTTP format
- [Scouts](https://agents-household.dev/docs/scouts/): specialists a bot calls for one task in their own VM; capabilities, network limits, owner approval (Run), secrets, results and threads
- [HTTP previews](https://agents-household.dev/docs/previews/): a bot shows a web app from its VM by a 15-minute link you approve; who can open it; limits
- [MCP servers](https://agents-household.dev/docs/mcp/): give a bot any MCP server by asking it; hosts and keys it needs, what persists, limits
- [Back up and move](https://agents-household.dev/docs/backup/): house export / house import, what a backup holds, moving to another machine

- [Setup](https://github.com/underwear/household/blob/main/plugins/household/skills/household/install.md): the checklist from a bare machine to a bot answering in Telegram
- [Operating](https://github.com/underwear/household/blob/main/plugins/household/skills/household/operate.md): what Household can do (bots, network, secrets, scouts), updates, backups
- [Debugging](https://github.com/underwear/household/blob/main/plugins/household/skills/household/debug.md): where to look when a bot, scout or channel does not work
- [Skill overview](https://github.com/underwear/household/blob/main/plugins/household/skills/household/SKILL.md): concepts

## Source

- [Repository](https://github.com/underwear/household): TypeScript on Bun; `house --help` lists every command
